metadata.name: Pennsylvania Aviation Development Program (ADP)
metadata.source_citation: PennDOT BOA Program Updates 2024 (https://www.pa.gov/content/dam/copapwp-pagov/en/penndot/documents/programs-and-doing-business/aviation/2024_pa_bureauofaviation_programupdates.pdf). BOA administers 4 grant programs (~$35M/year): Block Grant Program, Aviation Development Program (ADP), Capital Budget/Transportation Assistance Program, Real Estate Tax Reimbursement Program. JACIP role removed in 2024 update.

decisions_log.author: APH m49 Sprint 8 reference encoder
decisions_log.decision: Encoded Pennsylvania as additive_100pt model with bucket structure reflecting BOA's 4 programs. Used Aviation Development Program (ADP) as the primary discretionary path since it has the broadest scoring criteria.
decisions_log.rationale: BOA's published instructions describe 4 separate grant programs with distinct eligibility but a common scoring philosophy: safety > preservation > standards compliance > efficiency. JACIP was the historical evaluation system but has been simplified out of the process per the 2024 update.
decisions_log.source: BOA ADP Applicant Instructions and BOA 2024 Program Updates

criteria.label: Safety
criteria.description: BOA's top priority. Safety improvements at airfield, approach surfaces, RSA.

criteria.label: Federal/State Standards Compliance
criteria.description: Project brings airport into FAA/Commonwealth compliance.

criteria.label: Federal Funding Match
criteria.description: Block Grant program leverages federal AIP heavily; ADP supplements where AIP doesn't reach.

criteria.label: Pennsylvania Aviation System Role
criteria.description: Airport role in the PA Airport System Plan.

set_asides.label: Block Grant Program (federal AIP block)
set_asides.eligibility_filter: FAA Block Grant eligible airports - non-primary commercial service, reliever, and GA airports.

set_asides.label: Aviation Development Program (state discretionary)
set_asides.eligibility_filter: State-funded development projects, often filling federal gaps.

set_asides.label: Real Estate Tax Reimbursement
set_asides.eligibility_filter: Eligible airport sponsors with property tax obligations.

governance.decision_authority: PennDOT Bureau of Aviation; Pennsylvania Transportation Commission
governance.approval_process: BOA reviews applications across 4 grant programs (~$35M/year combined). 2024 update removed JACIP from the process to streamline ready-to-start projects.

disclaimer: TEMPLATE-STYLE ENCODING. PennDOT BOA documents the 4 grant programs and conceptual priorities but the specific scoring rubric is not publicly published. The 6-criterion framework and 100-point allocation are inferred from documented program priorities. PA stakeholders should obtain BOA's actual scoring methodology before adoption.
